name: trust
description: TLS server authentication by the operating system's trust, as Go's crypto/x509 does it: macOS's SecTrustEvaluateWithError and Windows's CertGetCertificateChain with the SSL policy, on a thread a poll loop waits on, and on Linux x509::verify against the system's anchors (its bundle and certificate directories, or SSL_CERT_FILE and SSL_CERT_DIR, read through the C library); SSL_CERT_FILE and SSL_CERT_DIR replace the system's verifier on macOS and Windows too, as in Go 1.27; a policy such as roots::policy (OneCRL, distrust dates) screens the path whichever verifies. system() also loads the anchors themselves on all three: macOS's trust domains with their SSL trust settings, Windows's ROOT store less what is disabled for server authentication or Disallowed A check answers with an x509::Approval; verify_blocking is for threads that may block.
